messages:
alex: Heads up — late-night deploybot run scheduled 00:30 UTC tonight to roll kernel v4.12 + quant-build v2.9. Need fallback window and release-note bullets. Who's oncall? @ops_lead

deploy-bot: scheduled run created: id=db-974, canary=2%, stagger=5m, estimated canary->full=1h30m. Preflight will run at T-10m.

mira: +1 for a 60-minute fallback window (3600s). If p50 latency up >30ms OR GPU temp spike >5C -> rollback immediately. Also watch KV-cache missrate.

sam: we should pin models to quant-abi v2 while the bundle settles. Suggest: pin TTL 6h after full. Avoid serving new unpinned variants for 24h.

ops_lead: I can cover oncall first 45m, ken takes over after. Alerts: p50 +30ms, tail latency p95 +150ms, error-rate +0.2% absolute.

julie: I'll draft release-note bullets: 1) kernel v4.12 perf/compat fixes 2) quant v2.9 lowbit changes 3) rollback criteria + contact list. Post to #announcements after canary green.

sam: small deploybot snippet for ops runbook:
```bash
deploybot run --bundle kernel@4.12 quant@2.9 \\\  --canary 0.02 --stagger 300 \\\  --fallback-window 3600 --pin "model:*:abi=v2 TTL=6h"
```

mira: add note: first 60s after canary may show higher latency due to KV cache warmup and quant table load. Mark that in RN.

ken: infra side: signatures and package checks already passed in staging. I ran quick thermal sim — looks ok but we'll monitor GPU mem reclaim.

deploy-bot: preflight checks: signatures=ok, checksums=ok, artefacts=present, compat-matrix=clear. Ready to start at 1749347400 (00:30 UTC). :rocket:

alex: OK. Launching at planned time. Julie will post RN draft to this thread before cutover. If canary fails, rollback to kernel@4.11 + quant@2.8 and unpin models.

julie: RN draft (will paste final before cutover):
- What: kernel v4.12 + quant v2.9 rollout
- Why: perf fixes, numeric stability for lowbit kernels
- Rollout plan: 2% canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (staggered, manual checks)
- Rollback criteria: p50 +30ms, p95 +150ms, error-rate +0.2% absolute, GPU temp +5C
- Oncall: ops_lead (T0-45m), ken (T45m+), mira (runtime leads)
- Post-rollback: pin models to ABI v2 for 6h, escalate to runtime@pager if persists

alex: Last call for objections. If none by T-5m, we proceed.

ken: no objections from infra.

mira: no objections. Ready to monitor.

julie: RN ready, posting after canary success.

alex: Go time in ~3m. I'll click deploy unless someone yells.

(END THREAD)
